classes.name: BaseRemoteEvent
classes.doc: The shared base of the event remotes.

classes.name: RemoteEvent
classes.doc: Sends one-way messages between the server and the clients. Arguments are deep copies; each message is delivered in order in the receiver's next phase, and messages that arrive before anything listens wait for the first connection.

methods.name: FireServer
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to the server, where OnServerEvent fires with the sending player first. Client only.

methods.name: FireClient
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to one player's client, where OnClientEvent fires. Server only.

methods.name: FireAllClients
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to every client. Server only.

events.name: OnServerEvent
events.doc: Fires on the server for each FireServer call, with the sending player and the copied arguments.

events.name: OnClientEvent
events.doc: Fires on a client for each FireClient or FireAllClients call that reaches it, with the copied arguments.

classes.name: UnreliableRemoteEvent
classes.doc: A RemoteEvent whose messages may be dropped or reordered on a real network. In one process every message arrives, in order.

methods.name: FireServer
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to the server, where OnServerEvent fires with the sending player first. Client only.

methods.name: FireClient
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to one player's client, where OnClientEvent fires. Server only.

methods.name: FireAllClients
methods.doc: Sends the arguments to every client. Server only.

events.name: OnServerEvent
events.doc: Fires on the server for each FireServer call, with the sending player and the copied arguments.

events.name: OnClientEvent
events.doc: Fires on a client for each FireClient or FireAllClients call that reaches it, with the copied arguments.

classes.name: RemoteFunction
classes.doc: Calls a function on the other side and waits for its results.

properties.name: OnServerInvoke
properties.doc: The server's handler: called with the invoking player and the arguments; what it returns goes back to the caller. Can be set, not read.

properties.name: OnClientInvoke
properties.doc: The client's handler for InvokeClient: called with the arguments; what it returns goes back to the server. Can be set, not read.

methods.name: InvokeServer
methods.doc: Calls the server's OnServerInvoke with the arguments and waits for its results. Waits until a handler is set. An error in the handler is raised here. Client only.

methods.name: InvokeClient
methods.doc: Calls a player's OnClientInvoke and waits for its results. An error in the handler, or the player leaving, is raised here. Server only.

classes.name: BindableEvent
classes.doc: Sends a message to scripts in the same context.

methods.name: Fire
methods.doc: Fires Event with deep copies of the arguments.

events.name: Event
events.doc: Fires for each Fire call, with the copied arguments.

classes.name: BindableFunction
classes.doc: Calls a function set by a script in the same context and waits for its results.

properties.name: OnInvoke
properties.doc: The handler Invoke calls with copies of the arguments; what it returns goes back to the caller. Can be set, not read.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.doc: Calls OnInvoke with copies of the arguments in a new thread and waits for its results. Raises RE9301 when no handler is set, and the handler's error when it raises.
